_comment: Wistia media hashed-IDs, grouped by the room key in screen.json.
Within a room the IDs are handed out in wall order (clockwise from the
doorway), so a room needs exactly as many IDs as it has screens: 7 each.
Keyed by room rather than by flat screen index on purpose -- the screens are
numbered in map-emission order, which interleaves (the Lenny room owns
0-5 AND 13, because its last wall is emitted after the whole branch loop).
Each ID is resolved to a CORS-enabled MP4 at runtime via
https://fast.wistia.net/embed/medias/<id>.json -- IDs only, no URLs to rot.
'labels' overrides the caption under the full-quality player. Without it the
caption is whatever the media is called in Wistia, which for the request
uploads is a filename ('Uploaded by Rachel via request - bob_10_years.mov').
Overriding here rather than renaming in Wistia keeps the library untouched
and means a caption cannot silently change because someone renamed a video.
Unlabelled IDs (the Lenny room) fall back to the Wistia title.

lenny: Lenny - A Better Way to Deliver Video
team: Uploaded by Thijs de Vries via request
